title: Park an Engineering Graph on a wait node and wake it with an external signal
task: Engineering Graph control plane: the graph must pause durably on a wait node until an external signal is delivered into its mailbox, then resume and consume that signal's payload.

nodes.task: `npm test` fails in this project. `formatBytes` in src/bytes.js stops at KB and rounds to whole kilobytes. Fix src/bytes.js so it steps through B, KB, MB, and GB in units of 1024, prints at most one decimal, and drops a trailing ".0" (0 -> "0 B", 1536 -> "1.5 KB", 1048576 -> "1 MB"). Do NOT edit anything under test/. Run `npm test` to verify.

notes: The harness enqueues the external signal into .seekforge/graphs/<id>.signals.json only after asserting that the first invocation stopped at "paused", so a graph that walked past its wait node fails before the signal exists. verify-graph.mjs then pins the wait node's resolved output to the exact delivered payload and requires the durable mailbox to be drained, which is the acknowledge-after-checkpoint contract.
